rows.question: Stroller route from Elmina Lakeside Mall to Surau At Taqwa?
rows.text:
Route status: partly unverified
There is a mapped stroller route of about 1,380 m (around 20 minutes) from Elmina Lakeside Mall to Surau At Taqwa, but most of its stretches have not been checked yet for steps, incline or width. About 932 m follows mapped sidewalks, and no stretch follows the road.
1. Start at Elmina Lakeside Mall and follow the mapped sidewalks towards Surau At Taqwa (about 1,380 m in total).
2. Cross the road crossings on the route, which are mostly unmarked on the map.
3. Arrive at the nearest mapped path to Surau At Taqwa, then look for the entrance on site, since it is not mapped.
Worth knowing:
• Unchecked on the route: steps, incline (%) and width (m) on an unnamed footway, unnamed sidewalks and unnamed crossings; steps, incline and width are not checked yet for the stroller limits (no steps, incline up to 8.3%, width at least 0.8 m).
• Asked the township team to check 10 of the 75 unchecked items; 65 more unchecked items are pending.
• This route uses 9 road crossings: 6 unmarked (map data, not checked), 3 with no recorded crossing type.
• Route ends at the nearest mapped path to Surau At Taqwa; its entrance is not mapped.
• Some recorded values on this route (steps, incline, width, and the Urban Park bench 3 rest point) are demo values, not yet surveyed.
• Outside the detailed study area (Elmina Urban Park + Lakeside Mall frontage), path and place facts come from OpenStreetMap only.
